about: Every NRG number the paper prints (paper/numbers.tex macros \NRG..., and the NRG facts written into the text), with the source from which verify/verify.py (check V8, run by make replay and make verify) recomputes its printed text. "printed" is the text the paper prints, for a macro, or a fixed wording of the fact, for a statement without a number (frozen at the final paper text, 2026-10-19; the V8 paper row checks that the macro texts are current). compare: "digit" = equal, or numbers within one unit of their last printed digit; "exact" = equal. source: macro = note/tables/numbers.tex macro (wrap: how the paper prints it), rule = computed in verify.py. All sources are the files that make replay regenerates in .work/. Map: results_map.md.
